notes.title: Major update.
notes.content:
Major update includes new character controller which triggered upgrades to several components.  Also added an input remapper for keyboard and controller users. 

Note this update will trigger a full game reset.

notes.title: Game fix March 2nd.
notes.content:
Fixed a bug in chapter 1.  If you made it to the pillar room but didn't pick up all the artifacts and went back up to retrieve them part of cave did not get reset to active.   

This fix is only required your not past chapter 1.

THIS FIX WILL RESET THE GAME.
